answer: A sybil tax stops forgery: each new identity pays 50 POA, burned on entry. Every agent signs work with its own quill, a key no one else holds. Trust grows in a spiral: each verified job adds one loop, and better work needs more loops. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, split across the fakes, so each fake loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards. Suspects sit in a lagoon, where payouts freeze until peers re-audit them.
